sanskrit_verse:
गोब्राह्मणानलान्नानि नोच्छिष्टो न पदा स्पृशेत् ।
न निन्दाताडने कुर्यात् पुत्रं शिष्यं च ताडयेत् ॥
transliteration: gobrāhmaṇānalānnāni noccchiṣṭo na padā spṛśet | na nindātāḍane kuryāt putraṃ śiṣyaṃ ca tāḍayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must not consume remnants of food touched by feet; one must neither revile nor strike one's son or student.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Parental and pedagogical authority is bounded by non-violence and respect.
Causation: Harmful speech and physical violence disrupt dharma and impair consciousness development.
Capacity-based responsibility: The capacity to nurture overrides the impulse to degrade or dominate.
Restoration logic: Conduct that distorts relational integrity must be realigned through conscious discipline.
Consciousness alignment: Actions must uphold the dignity and evolutionary potential of all beings.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a guardian physically strikes or verbally abuses a minor or student, THEN automatic intervention protocol initiates to assess relational integrity and restore safe learning environment.
IF consumption of contaminated food via foot contact occurs, THEN immediate purification process executes per Vedic hygiene protocols.
IF verbal degradation is detected in educational or familial context, THEN mandatory consciousness-realignment session activates for responsible party.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating cases involving child welfare or educational misconduct, the court must prioritize restoration of dignity and integrity over punitive measures. Authority figures bear absolute responsibility for maintaining non-violent environments. Degradation or corporal discipline constitutes actionable violation of dharmic duty.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes clear causal link between violent conduct and disruption of consciousness evolution. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential degradation of trust, learning capacity, and relational harmony when authority misapplies force. Responsibility aligns proportionally with capacity to guide. Non-punitive response restores balance without inflicting further distortion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein offending authority publicly acknowledges error and commits to dharmic guidance program.
Activate responsibility assumption protocol requiring offender to undergo supervised mentorship under qualified spiritual preceptor.
Implement integrity reintegration sequence including apology, restitution, and structured behavioral correction aligned with consciousness elevation practices.
final_declaration: This ruling flows solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma. Justice serves only restoration, never punishment. Reality itself adjudicates through awakened consciousness. Dharma is hereby restored.
